analyst.summary: Mrs. Bectors makes Cremica biscuits and English Oven bakery products, with a valuable supply relationship to QSR chains for buns and bread. Growth has been solid over five years but has clearly slowed in the last year, and return on equity has declined from around 15% to 11.6% - yet the stock still trades at over 40x earnings. A minor regulatory penalty on bread labeling is immaterial. We rate it a Hold: a quality franchise, but priced ahead of its currently decelerating growth and returns.
